proposals.before: (《Old Book of Tang》 states: Guangyi passed the civil service examination in the third year of Guangqi, was repeatedly promoted to Director of the Bureau of Merit in the Ministry of Personnel and Academician of the Hongwen Institute, and was later changed to Director of the Bureau of Provisions and Drafted Imperial Edicts.)
proposals.after: (《Old Book of Tang》 states: Guangyi passed the civil service examination in the third year of Guangqi, was repeatedly promoted to Director of the Bureau of Merit in the Ministry of Personnel and Academician of the Hongwen Institute, and was later changed to Director of the Bureau of Provisions, charged with drafting imperial edicts.)
proposals.reason: The office 知制诰 is the duty of drafting edicts, not a coequal post named Drafted Imperial Edicts.

proposals.before: After Jishu's deposition and enthronement, he traveled in the Jiangnan region to avoid calamity; Liu Yin of Lingnan treated him with deep courtesy, memorialized to appoint him as deputy commissioner, and thus he made his home beyond the mountains.)〉
proposals.after: After Jishu's coup of deposition and enthronement, he traveled in the Jiangnan region to avoid calamity; Liu Yin of Lingnan treated him with deep courtesy, memorialized to appoint him as deputy commissioner, and thus he made his home beyond the mountains.)〉
proposals.reason: The phrase 季述廢立 means Jishu deposed and installed emperors, not that Jishu himself was deposed.

proposals.before: Earlier there was a regulation: "When powerful families forcibly bought people's fields and houses, or framed them for confiscation and registration, and injustice was clearly obstructed, people were permitted to plead their own case."
proposals.after: Earlier there was a regulation: "When powerful families forcibly bought people's fields and houses, or framed them for confiscation and registration, and injustice was plainly evident, people were permitted to plead their own case."
proposals.reason: 屈塞 means grievance or being wronged, not physical obstruction; the idiomatic rendering already has this right.

proposals.before: When the matter reached the Secretariat, Guangyun said to Guo Chongyao, "Fu Gong conspired in rebellion with the Shannan faction and plainly deserved punishment under the law. Our dynasty has not yet cleared his name—how can his estates be claimed?"
proposals.after: When the matter reached the Secretariat, Guangyun said to Guo Chongtao, "Fu Gong conspired in rebellion with the Shannan faction and plainly deserved punishment under the law. Our dynasty has not yet cleared his name—how can his estates be claimed?"
proposals.reason: 崇韜 is Chongtao, not Chongyao; the same person is Guo Chongtao throughout Later Tang sources.

proposals.before: Chongyao privately blocked the eunuch's claim and submitted a full report to the throne.
proposals.after: Chongtao privately blocked the eunuch's claim and submitted a full report to the throne.
proposals.reason: 崇韜 should be romanized Chongtao, matching the Chinese name in this sentence.

proposals.before: Xilang argued: "My grand-uncle Fuguang rendered great service to the throne. My elder-uncle Fu Gong was framed by Zhang Jun and fell afoul of the former dynasty, when powerful ministers constrained the throne and imperial orders could not be enforced. After Wang Xingyu was executed, an edict of grace publicly cleared the record, and that edict still survives. Your Excellency is a hereditary minister of our dynasty and well versed in precedent—how can you say his name has not been cleared!
proposals.after: Xilang argued: "My grand-uncle Fuguang rendered great service to the throne. My elder grand-uncle Fu Gong was framed by Zhang Jun and fell afoul of the former dynasty, when powerful ministers constrained the throne and imperial orders could not be enforced. After Wang Xingyu was executed, an edict of grace publicly cleared the record, and that edict still survives. Your Excellency is a hereditary minister of our dynasty and well versed in precedent—how can you say his name has not been cleared!
proposals.reason: 伯祖 is a grandfather's elder brother (elder grand-uncle), not an elder uncle; 叔祖 is already correctly grand-uncle.

proposals.before: Zhang Quanyi spoke to Guo Chongyao about restoring him as chief minister, and he was soon recalled as guest of the heir apparent.
proposals.after: Zhang Quanyi spoke to Guo Chongtao about restoring him as chief minister, and he was soon recalled as guest of the heir apparent.
proposals.reason: 郭崇韜 is Guo Chongtao; Chongyao is a wrong romanization.

proposals.before: Before long Jue, citing old age, illness, and deafness, declared himself unfit for Secretariat duties and submitted four memorials asking to retire. Emperor Mingzong was reluctant but eventually consented, granting him the title grand master with golden seal and acting left vice director in retirement, together with an estate in Zheng Prefecture.
proposals.after: Before long Jue, citing old age, illness, and deafness, declared himself unfit for Secretariat duties and submitted four memorials asking to retire. Emperor Mingzong was reluctant but eventually consented, granting him the title kaifu yitong sansi and acting left vice director in retirement, together with an estate in Zheng Prefecture.
proposals.reason: 開府儀同三司 is not the golden-seal grand-master title (金紫光祿大夫).

proposals.before: Before long Jue, on grounds of old age, illness, and ear ailment, could not bear Secretariat duties; he submitted four memorials requesting release. Mingzong regretted it and only after a long time granted permission; he was then granted Grand Master with Golden Seal and Acting Left Vice Director with retirement, and was still bestowed one estate district in Zheng Prefecture.
proposals.after: Before long Jue, on grounds of old age, illness, and ear ailment, could not bear Secretariat duties; he submitted four memorials requesting release. Mingzong regretted it and only after a long time granted permission; he was then granted Kaifu Yitong Sansi and Acting Left Vice Director with retirement, and was still bestowed one estate district in Zheng Prefecture.
proposals.reason: The literal likewise mistranslates 開府儀同三司 as a golden-seal title.

proposals.before: His son You served as regular gentleman during the Taiping Xingguo era.
proposals.after: His son Gou served as a director of a bureau (zhenglang) during the Taiping Xingguo era.
proposals.reason: 遘 is Gou, not You; 正郎 is a bureau director rank, not 'regular gentleman'.

proposals.before: He was demoted to grand mentor of the heir apparent but was soon appointed vice minister of personnel.
proposals.after: He was demoted to supervisor of the household of the heir apparent but was soon appointed vice minister of personnel.
proposals.reason: 太子詹事 is the supervisor of the heir apparent's household, not the grand mentor (太傅).

proposals.before: He was demoted to Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent; before long he was appointed Vice Minister of Personnel.
proposals.after: He was demoted to Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent; before long he was appointed Vice Minister of Personnel.
proposals.reason: 太子詹事 is the zhanshi of the heir apparent's household, not Grand Mentor.

proposals.before: When Doulu Ge and Wei Yue fell from power, the court debated a new chief minister. Kong Xun did not want a man from the Hebei-Shandong region in the post. Ren Yuan favored Li Qi, but Zheng Jue had long been at odds with Qi and Kong Xun also disliked him. Kong told An Chonghui, "Li Qi is learned enough, but he is not honest.
proposals.after: When Doulu Ge and Wei Yue fell from power, the court debated a new chief minister. Kong Xun did not want a man from the region north of the Yellow River in the post. Ren Yuan favored Li Qi, but Zheng Jue had long been at odds with Qi and Kong Xun also disliked him. Kong told An Chonghui, "Li Qi is learned enough, but he is not honest.
proposals.reason: 河朔 denotes the lands north of the Yellow River, not a fused Hebei-Shandong region.

proposals.before: The court, considering national academy affairs weighty, ordered Xie additionally to adjudicate the Director of the National University; Xie memorialized that each year supplementing two hundred student monitors be fixed as standard, and public opinion criticized this.
proposals.after: The court, considering national academy affairs weighty, ordered Xie additionally to adjudicate the Director of the National University; Xie memorialized that each year supplementing two hundred National University students be fixed as standard, and public opinion criticized this.
proposals.reason: 監生 are Imperial Academy students, not student monitors.

proposals.before: His fifth-generation ancestor Cheng, at the end of the Tianbao era, served as minister of rites and surveillance commissioner of the Eastern Capital.
proposals.after: His fifth-generation ancestor Cheng, at the end of the Tianbao era, served as minister of rites and stay-behind regent of the Eastern Capital.
proposals.reason: 留守 is a stay-behind regent, not a surveillance commissioner (觀察使).

proposals.before: His fifth-generation ancestor Cheng, at the end of Tianbao, was Minister of Rites and Surveillance Commissioner of the Eastern Capital.
proposals.after: His fifth-generation ancestor Cheng, at the end of Tianbao, was Minister of Rites and Stay-behind Regent of the Eastern Capital.
proposals.reason: 東部留守 (for 東都留守) is stay-behind regent of the Eastern Capital, not Surveillance Commissioner.

proposals.before: The next year, after his mother's death, he wandered through the regions of Liu, Qi, and Lu.
proposals.after: The next year, after his mother's death, he wandered through Qi and Lu.
proposals.reason: 流寓 is the verb 'to sojourn', not a place named Liu; 齊、魯 are Qi and Lu only.

proposals.before: Yet with chaff to light firewood, making day into night, he read several thousand volumes, occasionally composing poems and rhapsodies.
proposals.after: Yet with chaff to light firewood, making night into day, he read several thousand volumes, occasionally composing poems and rhapsodies.
proposals.reason: 俾夜作晝/畫 means turning night into day; the literal reverses the direction.

proposals.before: Xi read the rhapsody with startled wonder, turned his shoes around to welcome him at the gate, produced Qi's 'Tuning the Mute Bell,' 'Holding Up the Sun,' and other rhapsodies, and said to Qi: "Your subject has often worried that in recent years literati rhapsodies, after several lines one still has not seen the rhapsody's topic. Your lordship from the opening lines reveals the topic, and the occasional classical elegance—ah!
proposals.after: Xi read the rhapsody with startled wonder, turned his shoes around to welcome him at the gate, produced Qi's 'Tuning the Mute Bell,' 'Holding Up the Sun,' and other rhapsodies, and said to Qi: "I have often lamented that in recent years literati rhapsodies, after several lines one still has not seen the rhapsody's topic. Your lordship from the opening lines reveals the topic, and the pairing is classically splendid—ah!
proposals.reason: 余嘗患 is Li Xi speaking of himself (I), not 臣/Your subject; 偶屬典麗 is parallel diction, not 'occasional'.

proposals.before: At the beginning of the Tianfu era he entered the Broad Learning and Eminent Rhetoric examination and placed in the fourth rank. He was appointed captain of Wei Gong County, then recruited as a transport circuit inspector, and later promoted to left remonstrating official and palace remonstrating censor.
proposals.after: At the beginning of the Tianfu era he entered the Broad Learning and Eminent Rhetoric examination and placed in the fourth rank. He was appointed captain of Wugong County, then recruited as a transport circuit inspector, and later promoted to left remonstrating official and palace remonstrating censor.
proposals.reason: 武功縣 is the county Wugong, not a personal name Wei Gong.

proposals.before: In Zhenming and Longde, successively Minister of War, Rites, and Personnel; ordered with Feng Xijia, Zhang Chong, and Xi Yinxiang jointly to compile 《Veritable Records of Emperor Taizu of Liang》 thirty volumes; promoted to Censor-in-Chief, repeatedly raised to Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
proposals.after: In Zhenming and Longde, successively vice minister of War, Rites, and Personnel; ordered with Feng Xijia, Zhang Chong, and Xi Yinxiang jointly to compile 《Veritable Records of Emperor Taizu of Liang》 thirty volumes; promoted to Censor-in-Chief, repeatedly raised to Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
proposals.reason: 侍郎 is vice minister, not minister; the idiomatic already has vice minister.

proposals.before: Once, while Qi was handling personnel matters during the examination season, he changed the provisional title 'acting' to 'holding office' in an appointment. Qing reported this, and the Liang emperor was furious and was about to banish him to the remote frontier. Zhao Yan and others intervened on his behalf. He was removed as chief minister and made crown prince junior tutor.
proposals.after: Once, while Qi was issuing an appointment with a probationary title, he changed 'acting' (攝) to 'keeping the post' (守). Qing reported this, and the Liang emperor was furious and was about to banish him to the remote frontier. Zhao Yan and others intervened on his behalf. He was removed as chief minister and made crown prince junior tutor.
proposals.reason: 試攝名銜 and 改攝為守 is a specific title-grade change (攝 vs 守), not 'examination season' and not acting→holding as currently glossed.

proposals.before: In Later Han, during the reign of Emperor An, when flood and drought left stores insufficient, the Three Excellencies memorialized that wealthy men who contributed grain might receive the rank of marquis within the passes or various honorary posts down to the level of the Three Excellencies.
proposals.after: In Later Han, during the reign of Emperor An, when flood and drought left stores insufficient, the Three Excellencies memorialized that wealthy men who contributed grain might receive the rank of marquis within the passes or honorary posts of the Three Excellencies and ministers and below.
proposals.reason: Gongqing yixia sanchief offices means honorary posts of the ministers and those below, not a scale ending at the Three Excellencies.

proposals.before: He also once memorialized at imperial order to compose the spirit-way stele text for Huo Yanwei.
proposals.after: He also once, by imperial command, composed the spirit-way stele text for Huo Yanwei.
proposals.reason: The wording feng chi zhuan (written qin chi) means he received an imperial command to compose the stele, not that he memorialized.

proposals.before: He also once memorialized at imperial order to compose the spirit-way stele text for Huo Yanwei.
proposals.after: He also once received imperial command to compose the spirit-way stele text for Huo Yanwei.
proposals.reason: Literal English repeats the idiomatic error; the source is a command to compose, not a memorial.

proposals.before: He was the grandson of the former official Xiang and the son of Lin, governor of Jingzhao.
proposals.after: He was the grandson of the former chief minister Fang and the son of Lin, governor of Jingzhao.
proposals.reason: 故相 names a former chief minister, not a generic official; 仿 is Fang, not Xiang.

proposals.before: Qing was quick-witted and skilled at prose. In the reign of Emperor Zhaozong he passed the jinshi examination and served in succession as transport circuit inspector, doctor of the Grand Ceremonies, and right supplementing remonstrator.
proposals.after: Qing was quick-witted and skilled at prose. In the reign of Emperor Zhaozong he passed the jinshi examination and served in succession as inspector of the Census Bureau, doctor of the Grand Ceremonies, and right supplementing remonstrator.
proposals.reason: 度支巡官 is a Census/Revenue (Duzhi) inspectorate post, not a transport appointment.

proposals.before: Earlier, when Zhang Jun left the Secretariat to become right vice director, Gao Shao, a judge on the staff of the Founder of Liang, had the Founder's yin request an initial appointment for a son. Every provincial ministry said there was no precedent, but Zhang Jun bent the rules to carry it out. His order was extremely urgent, and the clerks were terrified.
proposals.after: Earlier, when Zhang Jun left the Secretariat to become right vice director, Gao Shao, a judge on the staff of the Founder of Liang, had the Founder's yin request an initial appointment for a son. All the capital ministries and courts said there was no precedent, but Zhang Jun bent the rules to carry it out. His order was extremely urgent, and the clerks were terrified.
proposals.reason: 省寺 are the capital department and court offices, not provincial ministries.

proposals.before: When Emperor Zhuangzong took Bian, Qing was demoted to registrar of Deng Prefecture and soon transferred to vice prefect of Pu Prefecture.
proposals.after: When Emperor Zhuangzong took Bian, Qing was demoted to registrar of Deng Prefecture and transferred by commutation of place to vice prefect of Pu Prefecture.
proposals.reason: 量移 is a mitigated-exile transfer of posting, not a mere prompt transfer.
